COOLING - COOLANT
REPLACEMENT HINT:
For replacing the heater parts such a heater core or heater
hose, refer to AC-29.
1. DRAIN ENGINE COOLANT
(a) Remove the reservoir cap.
CAUTION:
To avoid the danger of being burned, do not remove the resà
ervoir cap while the engine and radiator are still hot, as
fluid and steam can be blown out under pressure.
(b) Loosen the radiator drain plug (on the left under side of
the radiator tank) and engine drain plug on the engine
coolant drain union (on the left rear of the cylinder block),
and drain the coolant.
(c) Close the drain plugs.
Torque: 12.7 N-m (130 kgf,cm1 9 ft,lbf) for engine
